claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jem Mace signed articles on January 17, 1870 to fight for $10,000 and the championship of the world.
claims.excerpt: The men signed to mix, January 17, 1870

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Jem Mace on May 10, 1870 under London Prize Ring rules, about eight miles from New Orleans at Kennerville, for $10,000 and the championship of the world.
claims.excerpt: They met the May 10, following, within ten miles of the city of New Orleans
places: Kennerville, about eight miles from New Orleans

claims.statement: Tom Allen trained for the Mace fight in St. Louis under Jack Goulding and Joe Coburn.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was 27 years old when he fought Jem Mace on May 10, 1870, according to Bill Clark.

claims.statement: Tom Allen weighed 175 pounds on the day of the Mace fight.
